text:
lina: quick sync — during the int8 bring-up on skylark last night we saw a small but consistent spike in paraphrase false positives coming from a narrow cohort of short-context prompts. think it's sampling + our dedupe fingerprint thresholds interacting with quant noise. can someone help rotate the seedbank and adjust the sampler?

omar: I can own the sampler tweak. can you paste the failing sample query? I'll run a localized resample and check distribution shifts.

lina: thanks. here's the query i used to pull the cohort: ```sql
SELECT id, prompt, fingerprint, embed_v1
FROM prompt_store
WHERE length(prompt) < 120
  AND cohort_tag = 'holdout_paraphrase_v2'
  AND last_labeled_at > now() - interval '60 days'
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 2000;
```

omar: nice, reproduces locally. i see a bump in near-duplicate clusters after quant. i'll widen the fingerprint radius from 0.78 -> 0.74 and add a delayed-decay sampler window to favor older seeds. i'll open a PR.

maria: fyi embedding fingerprint drift looks real — cosine similarities down ~0.03 on median after the int8 kernels switch. that explains more collisions. two suggestions: (1) recalc embeddings for the active golden holdout with the new model binary, (2) add a small synthetic paraphrase augmentation set to the golden so we can track regressions explicitly.

lina: +1 on recalcing golden. label_ops — what's your capacity to relabel a 500-sample refreshed golden? we need high-consistency labels (3-way agreement).

label_ops: we have 8 labelers this week. 500 with 3x redundancy is doable but needs a day buffer. ETA start tomorrow AM, finish EOD. will run spot QC and send disagreements to the adjudication queue.

dave: quick note from the quant side — some of the failure modes are tied to a specific attention kernel fallback on A100s when sequence len < 64. switching to the fallback introduces small embedding perturbations. i'm testing a patch that forces the fast kernel for short seqs; might reduce drift. will post benchmarks in the PR.

aya: can we also add an evaluation slice for token overlap vs. embedding sim? want to surface if collisions are lexical or semantic. i can wire up a small dashboard panel in console under "evals/quant-interop".

omar: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/curation/pull/482 — sampler changes + fingerprint threshold. includes unit test for cluster stats.

lina: plan recap: (1) dave merges kernel patch if stable, (2) omar merges sampler PR, (3) maria re-embeds golden + upload, (4) label_ops runs 3x relabel pass, (5) aya adds dashboard slice to monitor token-vs-embed divergence. target finish by EOD tomorrow.

dev-bot: deploy scheduled: sampler-config v1.22 -> staging at 2024-08-12T09:40Z (by omar).

maria: posting the refreshed golden uploads here when ready: s3://redwood-curation/goldens/paraphrase_v2_recalc_20240812.tar.gz

label_ops: starting labeling run 08:30 PT tomorrow. tagging all jobs with `curation/quant-interop/aug1`.

lina: thanks all — ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
